checks: Exact receiving creates usable stock once, no issue/task, and no further receiving eligibility
Arriving-later choice saves delivered goods and leaves an ordinary pending balance without a claim
One multi-category investigation task contains purchase/supplier/receipt/prices and holds only the disputed missing quantities
Legacy/stale requests cannot receive held stock; split treatment and idempotent replay do not duplicate stock or tasks
Invoice line pricing and original FX automatically estimate claims without double counting bags plus weight or creating cash
Approved supplier credit closes missing quantities and completes one linked task without requiring credit use or permitting receiving again
Supplier and purchase list APIs expose consistent actionable pending indicators
New task details localize generated context without rewriting the immutable invoice estimate or original audit text
Refund agreement closes receiving but keeps the task pending until the actual cash receipt is recorded
Authorized replacement has a dedicated remaining allowance, fulfills the original shortage once, and hides further receiving
A negotiated valuation needs an explicit reason; invalid submissions create no partial work and foreign keys reconcile
